verdict.rationale: Twilio Voice documents automated answering of incoming calls, gathering caller input and recording calls without a person picking up. That covers answering the line and taking a message, and a community user corroborates voicemail-to-webhook with transcription. Nothing in the pack shows an AI agent conducting the call or a documented handoff to a human agent. missing for 10: evidence of an AI conversational agent answering calls, a documented live handoff/transfer to a human, and first-party docs describing the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: respond to incoming phone calls, gather user input, record calls, and take payments without needing a person to answer the phone
